en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Musa Bin Al Qasim, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Al Hassan Bin Jahm who said,
‘Abu Al-Hassanasws came out to me, so I found from himasws an aroma of Al-Tajmeer (incense)’.
en.sarwar: 3. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Musa ibn al-Qasim from Ali ibn Asbat from al-Hassan ibn Jahm who has said the following: “
Once abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, came out and I felt the fragrance of incense from him (the Imam).”’
